senses.gloss: (Arab. vasha colorare) to color, stain.—Ithp. אִיתְוַוס, אִיתְוִיס, אִיתְוְוסָא to be stained, soiled.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 75b:1">Sabb. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>דלִיתְוַוס בית השחיטה</he> (Ms. M. <he>דניתְוִיס</he>) that the throat of the slaughtered animal be stained with blood.

<cite ref="Shabbat 124b:21">Ib. 124ᵇ</cite> <he>אִתְווּס מסנאיה טינא</he> Ms. O. (ed. <he>אתווסאי</he>, Ar. ed. Koh. <he>איתווס מאניה</he>; ed. Sonc. <he>אִתְוְוסֵי</he>) his shoes were soiled with mud.
<cite ref="Pesachim 65b">Pes. 65ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 35a:9">Zeb. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>מִיתְוְוסֵי מאנייהו</he> their garments would be soiled (with blood).
<cite ref="Yoma 53a:25">Yoma 53ᵃ</cite> <he>מִתְוְוסָן אסקופתא וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. 2 <he>מִתְוְוסָא</he> sing.) the thresholds &c.—

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 18a">B. Kam. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>דמתווס בלישא</he> Ar. a. Ms. F. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80, ed. <he>דמאוס</he>, corr. acc.) the rope was covered with dough (which attracted the chickens).
